Pairs on Faculties

I. Summary Chapter on Terms (Pan. n. attivāra Uddesa)

(There are) twenty-two faculties: eye faculty, ear faculty, nose 1. faculty, tongue faculty, body faculty, mind faculty, femininity faculty, masculinity faculty, life faculty, (bodily) pleasure faculty, (bodily) pain faculty, (mental) joy faculty, (mental) grief faculty, equanimity faculty, faith faculty, energy faculty, mindfulness faculty, concentration faculty, understanding faculty, “I-shall-come-to-know-the-unknown” faculty, final-knowledge faculty, final-knower faculty.
